what: The block-no-verify PreToolUse hook rejects any Bash command that contains the text "git commit" together with a token starting "-n" — even "-nowarn" inside a heredoc of plan text. To append such text to a file, write it with the Write tool to a scratchpad file, then `cat` it on in a command that has no "git commit" in it. Separately, the user preferred subagent-driven execution for the 10-task Plan 1b.
why: Hit while writing the Plan 1b plan on 2026-10-20; the hook gives no hint that a false positive is the cause.
